answer: Jurors sign a verdict, and diverging signatures get both sides slashed until a quorum agrees. That is what breaks first: an honest juror on a slow node is slashed next to a bad one, which is why slashes hold 24 hours before settling. Replay submissions against recent entries, since a new name proves nothing. Recruit misbehaviour burns the recruiter's escrow in the same transaction. Cost: 40 keys need 40 juries and lose escrow on every misbehaving key, and the onyx log records each replay hit, so a canyon of identical submissions narrows to one vertex fast.
